name: Glowfin Trailers
description: Fetches movie and show trailers from their online trailer links, so Glowfin can play them in its own player.
overview: Online trailers for the Glowfin Apple TV app

versions.changelog: First release: fetches a movie's or show's YouTube trailer onto the server (yt-dlp, H.264/AAC MP4, cached) so Glowfin can play it in its own player.
